name: Every Translated Key Is Reachable
note: Seventy-two keys had accumulated with no caller — 852 translated strings kept in sync across thirteen languages for nothing. The scan had been reporting them at NOTE severity, a tier nothing acts on. This gate is that finding promoted to something that fails.

mutations.name: the last caller of a key is deleted, leaving the translations behind
mutations.why: This is exactly how the seventy-two accumulated. A screen gets rewritten, the new key is added, the old one is never removed, and gate 1 then keeps all thirteen languages in sync on the dead half forever.

mutations.name: a translation is added that nothing will ever render
mutations.why: A key introduced ahead of the screen that was going to use it, and then the screen never arrived. Thirteen translators are billed for it anyway.
